title: Auto Team Armor Trim
description: Auto Trims Armor To Your Specific Team Color. Useful for Large Scale Events.
body:
# **How to Install?**
- Drag and Drop the zip file in your datapacks folder
- Reload the game with /reload

# **How to Use?**
- There are 4 Teams currently in this datapack. (Red, Blue, Yellow, Green)
- Join a Specific Team using /team join
- Equip Any Armor and it will auto trim and color it to your team.
